firstly i've fit 5 logisitc model one for each comparison.

i would like to fit a unique model, setting the control group as baseline for all the oter groups. 

so in the Methylkit documentation , i red that this 

" the inclusion of additional treatment indicators is analogous to multiple regression when there are categorical variables with multiple groups."

my question is: do i have to fit a multinomial logistic model?

thank you 

Matilde

Hi, I don't completely understand your question but you can't fit a model with more than two groups. with the development version you can but a) it is not very well tested b) in that case you will get regions/bases that has any difference between the groups you won't be able to set one as "baseline"

Best,
Altuna
